answer: Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the nadir is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
